content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products online has become increasingly complex, with many platforms imposing restrictions and fees on creators. The traditional approach relies on third-party payment processors like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, which take a significant cut of the revenue. However, with the rise of blockchain technology and decentralized payment systems, creators now have an alternative: a sovereign digital commerce stack on Solana, powered by NOWPayments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Solana-based commerce stack is built on a decentralized architecture, where creators have full control over their infrastructure. The stack consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This setup ensures that creators retain ownership of their data and revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
A sovereign digital commerce stack on Solana using NOWPayments eliminates fees and intermediaries.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of the Solana-based commerce stack include NOWPayments for payment processing, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This integrated system ensures seamless and automatic delivery of digital products, eliminating the need for intermediaries and associated fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack on Solana using NOWPayments, you can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. This comprehensive package provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your commerce infrastructure. Alternatively, you can contact COREMERCH to discuss custom deployment options. Visit the shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.

The most important question is: can I sell digital products online without relying on third-party payment processors? The answer is yes, with a sovereign digital commerce stack on Solana using NOWPayments. This setup provides full control over your infrastructure, eliminating fees and intermediaries. With the Solana-based commerce stack, you can retain ownership of your data and revenue, and deploy your digital products instantly.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack on Solana using NOWPayments, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) or contact COREMERCH for custom deployment options; configure GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting; set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic; integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery; and set up NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Deploy your digital products instantly and retain full control over your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Solana-based commerce stack?

To integrate NOWPayments with your Solana-based commerce stack, follow the provided documentation and configure your payment gateway according to your specific use case. This may involve setting up API keys, webhooks, and other necessary integrations to ensure seamless payment processing.
Can I use other blockchain networks besides Solana?

While Solana is the recommended network for low fees, other blockchain networks like BSC, TRON, and Ethereum can also be used with NOWPayments. However, please note that fees and transaction times may vary significantly depending on the chosen network.
How do I configure my Solana-based commerce stack for automatic crypto payment verification?

To configure your Solana-based commerce stack for automatic crypto payment verification, follow the provided documentation and set up NOWPayments according to your specific use case. This may involve configuring API keys, webhooks, and other necessary integrations to ensure seamless payment processing.
Can I sell digital products in multiple currencies?

Yes, with NOWPayments, you can sell digital products in multiple cryptocurrencies, including but not limited to BTC, USDT, and ETH. The payment processing is automatic, and the seller retains the revenue in their chosen cryptocurrency.
How do I scale my Solana-based commerce stack for high-traffic sales?

To scale your Solana-based commerce stack for high-traffic sales, follow the provided documentation and configure your infrastructure according to your specific use case. This may involve setting up load balancers, caching mechanisms, and other necessary integrations to ensure seamless and automatic delivery of digital products.
